This is the markdown version of the [PyAutoCortex Dashboard](https://pyautolabs.github.io/PyAutoCortex/), which puts the check-in and each project's resume prompt on your clipboard with a single tap of 📋.

One ledger per science project: what is on the cluster right now, what the human said they would do next, and the last few things they wrote down. Nothing here is inferred from a result — the board hands you the check-in and the resume prompt; what a run meant is yours to log.
